issues.title: Cannot load CoreMapping in Story Book
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Get error when load CoreMapping in Story Book

**Update from Ian:** I _expect_ this is because there are no delta messages in the storybook. Here is the trace:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/55d910f2-5d27-4631-911d-cf30004aa0aa)

When I added the type for deltaMessages (see highlight below) VS-Code showed some compiler issues that would probably solve the above issue:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/221ec869-b0a6-4e07-ba5e-119c9a14716f)


## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to 'Story Book' page
2. Click 'CoreMapping' > select 'Default'
3. Notice screen show the error page instead of the core mapping

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/96f28bcc-b8c0-48cf-9a7c-a8a01be45606)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
It should show the 'CoreMapping' page instead without error

## 🖥️ Screenshots

## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
